scope: Primary statements and theorem inputs actually used in the round-12 Erdős #679 workflow.

sources.role: Current OPEN statement, separation of the first question from the disproved additive-constant second question, and bibliography.

sources.citation: P. Erdős, Some unconventional problems in number theory, Acta Math. Acad. Sci. Hungar. 33 (1979), 71--80, p. 72, formulas (3)--(4).

sources.role: Lau's C log k theorem; official TeX definitions of eta, tilde-eta, W, R_k and nu; denominator formula giving total weight x^(0.4+o(1)); conditional Section 7 boundary.
Tao--Teräväinen weaker O(k) context and the inherited sieve architecture.
Steve Fan's modern all-level statement of the uniform Hardy--Ramanujan inequality and sifted-set theorem; the latter was audited and not applied to growing forms Wa-k.
Goudout Theorems 1--2 for local omega laws and the formally proved fixed-b two-shift corollary, used with b=1.
Tenenbaum Theorem 1 for joint local omega laws at any fixed number of polynomial arguments; inherited all-fixed-log-power candidate sparsity revalidated with a no-fixed-divisor shift family.
Menon's July 2026 almost-all short-interval theorem for 1-bounded multiplicative functions; audited as not covering the required growing positive saddle.
Spiro's arithmetic-progression Sathe--Selberg theorem; its modulus range is only a fixed power of log x and does not cover Lau's W=x^(0.6+o(1)).

inherited_repository_inputs.role: Earlier record of the Tenenbaum arbitrary-fixed-dimension consequence; round 12 classifies it as inherited/revalidated.

inherited_repository_inputs.path: round-11 #679 report and QA in the repository campaign artifacts
inherited_repository_inputs.role: Inherited fixed-margin low-conductor ANOVA reduction; round 12 moves the entropy cutoff and re-audits its errors.

source_hypothesis_notes: Goudout's candidate-density estimate uses only the paper's proved fixed b=1 corollary, not its remark about more shifts.
Tenenbaum is applied to Q_j(m)=m-jP_r with P_r the product of primes at most r. This avoids the fixed-prime-divisor failure of consecutive shifts.
Fan's sifted-set theorem is not claimed to apply to omega(Wa-k) when W and k grow.
Spiro is used only to rule out a direct citation at modulus W; no extrapolation beyond the stated polylogarithmic range is made.
Menon's theorem is not extrapolated from 1-bounded functions to the positive saddle z much larger than 1.
warnings: No exhaustive novelty, priority, publication, or journal-quartile claim is made.
The Tenenbaum all-fixed-C sparsity estimate is inherited and is not counted as a new round-12 result.
Almost-all and density-zero statements do not settle the original existence quantifier.
Finite symbolic calculations are regression audits only and are not asymptotic evidence.
The original first question remains OPEN and original_problem_closures equals 0.
